title.narrative: Strengthening HIV prevention, reduction of tuberculosis and building resilient health systems - Botswana (01-Jan-2025-31-Dec-2027)

description.narrative: Botswana, TB/HIV, Botswana-Ministry of Health (Ministry of Health)This program has the following goals: Zero New infection by 2030. Zero AIDS Related Death by 2030. Zero Discrimination by 2030. End TB Pandamic by 2035. The objectives of this program are: Accelerate Implementation and enhance efficiencies towards HIV epidemic control beyond 2024. Improve Health Systems for HIV and TB Services. To increase TB treatment coverage from 60 percent in 2025 to 80 percent in 2027 by innovatively addressing barriers to access, utilization, and the needs of the key and vulnerable populations for TB care and prevention services. To expand access to quality TB diagnostic services, including the adoption of new diagnostic technologies. To increase RR/MDR-TB cases detected from 79 to 130 from 2025 to 2027 respectively.. To Strengthen management of co-morbidities including collaborative TB/HIV activities, and Prevention of TB for persons at high risks
